messages:
alex: Hi team — customer reports the app goes blank after clicking "Generate" on the playground. They can reproduce repeatedly. CS asked for a concise HAR + console dump to attach to the ticket (#5467). Can someone paste the exact steps we want customers to follow (Chrome/Firefox/Edge) so we don't miss headers or request IDs?

maria: Yep — paste this to them. Keep it short, numbered, and call out redaction.

maria: 1) Reproduce in Chrome (stable) in an Incognito window: Open the page and reproduce the blank screen.
- Open DevTools: Menu -> More tools -> Developer tools or press Ctrl+Shift+I (Cmd+Opt+I on mac).
- In DevTools > Network tab: check "Preserve log" and "Disable cache".
- Click the record button (red dot) if it's not recording.
- Re-do the action that causes the bug (click Generate).
- Right-click anywhere in the network list -> "Save all as HAR with content" and save as a .har file.

maria: 2) Console logs: In DevTools > Console tab: right-click -> "Save as..." or select all (Ctrl+A) and copy into a .txt. Make sure "Levels" includes "Info" and "Verbose" so we capture warnings. Also enable "Preserve log" in Console.

maria: 3) Important headers & metadata to include in your message:
- Any response/request header named X-Request-ID or x-rw-trace (or similar).
- The request URL for the failing XHR/websocket.
- Timestamp of reproduction (local time + timezone).

maria: 4) If they can share the failing network entry, ask them to right-click that single request -> "Copy" -> "Copy as cURL" and paste the curl here. We can run it from our side.

maria: 5) Privacy note: Ask them to redact Authorization headers, cookie values, API keys, and any PII before uploading. If they don't want to redact, they can send it to us via the secure Zendesk attachment.

maria: 6) Attachments: Please upload the .har and console .txt and name them like: customer5467_1765427890.har and customer5467_console_1765427890.txt. Zip them if needed.

alex: Add a short sample curl for guidance so they can see what we expect (remember to redact token):

alex: ```
# example (redact token)
curl 'https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data-raw '{"model":"gpt-4x","input":"hello"}'
```

tyler: For Firefox: open DevTools (F12) -> Network -> check "Persist Logs" -> reproduce -> right-click -> "Save all as HAR". Console: Web Console -> click the gear -> enable "Show content messages".

tyler: If they can't produce a HAR, ask them to: 1) screenshot the Network tab showing the failing request (headers + response pane), 2) copy the console errors (text). That often helps.

tyler: Also mention we need the page URL and whether any browser extensions were enabled. They should try Incognito to rule out extensions.

alex: If they paste the "Copy as cURL" output, we will: 1) redact keys, 2) run it against a test environment, 3) compare response/latency.

alex: Quick troubleshooting checklist we can run before HAR: 1) Confirm repro in Incognito, 2) Try another region (if available), 3) Check for consistent X-Request-ID across retries.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-47 (auto) — linked to ticket #5467.

maria: Perfect. I'll send this to CS and request the HAR + console + the "Copy as cURL" output. If they upload, I'll add to the ticket and ping @tyler for reproductions on staging.

alex: Thanks — tagging @tyler for potential follow-up.

tyler: Happy to take it. If we get the HAR, I can extract the failing request and provide a replay curl and sampling of request/response times.

maria: One last note to CS: ask them to include the browser version (chrome://version) and OS. If mobile, ask for device + OS version and whether they're on app or browser.

alex: Great. Closing the loop — CS will send instructions to the customer and attach everything to #5467.
